TC-21/S11.title: Deep links: own chart survives a re-open in each context; the other context's id never renders
TC-21/S11.detail: Local 25acd727 (page.goto twice stands in for a reload). Judged 4/4 (U6): /snf/<resident> twice shows the resident chart with 'Admission Summary', no sign-in gate; /rounding/<patient> twice shows the Hospital chart with 'Background Summary'; /snf/<Hospital patient id> never renders the Hospital patient; /rounding/<resident id> never renders the resident. Our own addition (record only, suggestion): both swapped routes land on the error boundary 'Something went wrong on this screen. Your saved notes are safe on the server. Reload to continue…' instead of a not-found or the list (the chart queries take v.id of the other table and throw an argument validation error); the next normal navigation to /rounding shows the list again. No wrong patient is shown, no data is lost.
